releases.notes:
Mirrors your **Minecraft 1.21.11 (Fabric)** hotbar onto an **Elgato Stream Deck**, and lets you select hotbar slots by pressing a key.

Client-side only · localhost only · no automation.

---

## You need BOTH downloads

They are two halves of one thing. Neither does anything alone.

| Download | Where it goes |
|---|---|
| **`deckcraft-hotbar-0.1.0.jar`** | your `.minecraft/mods` folder (with **Fabric API**) |
| **`com.fluffybacon.deckcraft-hotbar.streamDeckPlugin`** | **double-click it** — installs into the Stream Deck app |

Requirements: Minecraft **1.21.11** + Fabric Loader + **Fabric API**, Java 21, Stream Deck app **6.5+**, and Stream Deck hardware.

## Setup

1. Drop the jar in `mods`, alongside Fabric API.
2. Double-click the `.streamDeckPlugin` file.
3. Drag the **Hotbar Slot** action onto 9 keys and set each key's slot — or import the ready-made profile from `streamdeck-plugin/dist` in the repo for a one-step 15-key layout.
4. Launch Minecraft and join a world.

On its first launch the plugin generates item icons from **your own** Minecraft installation, in the background — usually under a minute. Keys show item names until it finishes, then repaint with real art. If Minecraft isn't installed for your user, keys simply keep showing names, which works fine.

## What it does

- All 9 hotbar slots with the selected slot highlighted, updating live
- Real item icons — vanilla, **your installed mods**, and **your enabled resource packs**
- Stack counts, durability bars, enchantment markers
- Optional read-only mirror of your 27 storage slots, 4 armor slots and off-hand
- Clear "No MC" / "No World" states, with automatic reconnection

## What it does not do

Pressing a key performs exactly one action: **select a hotbar slot** — identical to pressing `1`–`9`. It does not automate attacks, clicks, item use or aim; does not modify movement; and never moves, drops or duplicates items. Storage, armor and off-hand keys are display-only.

It talks only to `127.0.0.1` on your own machine and never sends data anywhere else. It reads nothing beyond your own inventory — no chat, no other players, no containers, no world data.

> Some servers disallow client-side mods in general. You are responsible for the rules of servers you join.

## Notes

- No Minecraft assets are redistributed. Item art is generated locally from your own installation; CI enforces that neither download contains game assets.
- Icons are a snapshot — re-run extraction after adding mods or changing resource packs (see the README).
- A 15-key Stream Deck MK.2/V2 fits the whole hotbar plus off-hand and all four armor slots. Other models need manual key layout.
